# fco_managed_vm_domains (Data Source)

Lists all Windows domains available to the tenant in a datacenter location.

Access the results via `fco_managed_vm_domains.<name>.domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List Windows domains available to the tenant in a datacenter location.
# `location_uuid` is required.
data "fco_managed_vm_domains" "in_location" {
  location_uuid = data.fco_managed_vm_locations.all.locations[0].uuid
}

# Access with `fco_managed_vm_domains.in_location.domains`.
# e.g. fco_managed_vm_domains.in_location.domains[0].uuid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_uuid` (String) The UUID of the datacenter location to list domains for. This is required by the API.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The list of Windows domains available to the tenant in the given location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed domains.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the Windows domain.
- `tenant` (String) The tenant this Windows domain belongs to.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the Windows domain.
